# CBDB-Desktop: Associations (Look At Associations) label revisions, 2026-10-26

Second form in the review of HTML labels against the MS Access FormLabels table (form code LAA). The first, Association Pairs, is in "Association Pairs label revisions (Oct 26 2026)"; decisions made there (查詢 over 詢查, 于 in both Chinese modes, 指數 over 索引) are applied here too. Changes are in the Associations form's index.html only. The page script was syntax-checked. **Not yet tested in the running app**; spacing and fit are still to be checked.

## How to revert a label

All labels are in the translations object near the top of the script, under english, traditional and simplified. To go back to the earlier wording, change the value of the key in the **Key** column, in the language concerned. Changed lines have a comment naming their FormLabels row (for example // LAA 6).

For the control marked **†**, the English text is also written directly in the HTML element. setLanguage('english') overwrites it on load, so editing translations.english is enough.

from and to are shown with a colon added by setLanguage (t.from + ':'), so the values themselves have no colon.

## Notes on individual changes

**LBL-13.** LAA 6 covers only Save to GIS. Save to KML was given the same pattern.

**LBL-14.** "Export Neo4j" was the only export button on this form not worded "Save to …", and the Association Pairs form calls the same function "Save to Neo4j". Revert if "Export" was intended to distinguish the Neo4j zip from the GIS files.

**LBL-15.** "Association Records" (關係記錄) and 人物 were shorter. 社會關係的人 is the longest tab label on the form; check it fits.

**LBL-16.** FormLabels has 指數年 (BIO 2); the form had 索引年份. The 2026-10-16 report left open whether index year should be 指數年 or 指數年份. 指數年 was used, matching the table and Association Pairs.

**LBL-17.** The Select Dynasties button had no id, so it couldn't be translated. It now has id="btnSelectDynasty", a selectDynasties key in all three blocks, and a line in setLanguage. Unlike Association Pairs, this form already refreshed the dynasty summary on language change.

**Comment updated.** The comment above translations said that from, to, runQuery, people and other keys had the same values as on the Status form. That is no longer true, so the comment now points to this report. The Status form will need the same changes when it is reviewed.

**LBL-18.** 匯出 was chosen over 導出 for the traditional label, matching Association Pairs. The simplified label stays 导出查询结果, also matching Association Pairs (导出 is the usual mainland term).

**Store Person IDs.** 储存人物ID (simplified) was confirmed as correct and is unchanged here. Association Pairs uses 保存人物ID and is to be changed to match (see that form's report).

**Display Language.** Translating "Display Language:" was confirmed as the approach for all forms. Unchanged here; to be added to Association Pairs.

## ASC-1: Sub-units and Use XY

**Change.** Both checkboxes start disabled. handleAddressSelection enables them when the address picker returns a selection. **All** (clearAddress()) unticks and disables them again, through a new helper, setAddrOptionsEnabled(enabled). This matches the Status and Texts forms (STA-2, TXT-2).

**Markup.** Each checkbox was inside its &lt;label&gt;, with the text in a &lt;span&gt;. They are now written as checkbox followed by &lt;label for=…&gt;, so the global disabled-label rule in cbdb_styles.css (CSS-1) greys the text while disabled. The ids lblSubUnits and lblUseXY moved from the &lt;span&gt;s to the &lt;label&gt;s, so setLanguage is unchanged. The chk-sep class, previously on the Use XY &lt;label&gt;, is now on a &lt;span&gt; wrapping that checkbox and label. **Check the spacing in this row**, since the markup around it changed.

## Issues

1. **"…" buttons.** Both the association and address pickers open from a "…" button with no tooltip. LAA 4 ("Select Association" / 選擇社會關係) could be used as the association button's tooltip (title) without changing the layout, and an equivalent for the address button. Not done; decide whether wanted.
1. **Title bar.** The page title is fixed text in mixed languages ("CBDB — Look At Associations / 查看關係"), has no id and is not translated. Association Pairs translates its title.
1. **Display Language.** Settled: translated on all forms (see the notes above).
1. **Cross-form wording.** Export Query Results (匯出) and Store Person IDs (储存) are now settled; see LBL-18. Still open: "Sub-units" / 子單位 here, "Include sub-units" on the Status form.
1. **Placeholders.** The association box placeholders are "(association)" and the simplified "(关系)" in every language; they are not translated.
1. **Other hard-coded text.** Results-table headers, the "No results yet" line, status-bar messages and the export file-name prompt are English only.

## Still to check in the running app

- Fit of the tab labels 社會關係的人 / 社会关系的人 and of "Save to Neo4j" / 保存于Neo4j.
- Select Dynasties in each language.
- "From:" / "To:" rows with 始年: / 終年:.
- ASC-1: on opening, Sub-units and Use XY are disabled with grey labels; selecting an address enables them; ticking both and clicking All unticks and disables them. Spacing of the row is unchanged.
